inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "Empty Bloodridge sunken crypt battle stage, rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Modern high quality pixel art like Sea of Stars: bright, colourful and readable, never muddy. A war torn brutal planet where everything wants to kill everything, told with absurd deadpan humour. A fortified kill zone: sharpened spike walls, a catapult aimed at the arena, a horned beast chained to a tree, skulls on pikes, war banners, and a cheerful skeleton merchant selling souvenirs. This picture is the left edge of a long connected region that ends at the sunken crypt far to the right: here is the outskirts where the region starts, the bare minimum: mostly open ground and only a few things, but still the same hostile place. It continues the scene at its right edge seamlessly, with the same horizon, the same ridge, the same arena floor height and the same light.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand pixelled 2D game battle stage background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair stepped contours everywhere. Flat colour clusters, two to four shades per material. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. Clean readable shapes. No paint brushwork, no gradients except a dithered sky, no noise texture.", "aesthetics": "bright readable war torn battle stage with absurd deadpan humour, coherent pixel clusters", "lighting": "Bright warm daylight from the upper left, cool blue shadows, as discrete flat pixel colour planes, the arena in calm even light.", "color_palette": ["#5aa6e4", "#b0daf0", "#f6e4c4", "#9692c4", "#ecb050", "#b46e3c", "#d04a3a", "#56925c", "#96a0bc", "#3a3a52", "#e8e0d0"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "One continuous 2.5D battle stage seen from a fixed side oblique camera like a classic arcade game stage, no people. The top third is sky over the distant Bloodridge burial ridge. Along the back runs a band of scenery: the sparse approach: a few warning stakes with skulls on top; a lone crooked wooden post; open packed ground with a few rocks; vultures circling far away. The lower two thirds is one wide open flat arena floor, empty, calm and even. The whole picture continues seamlessly into the scene at its right edge.", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 0, 330, 1000], "desc": "a bright clear sky with circling vultures over the long Bloodridge burial ridge on the horizon, carved with tomb terraces and dark tomb doors, the chief's stepped pyramid court on its crest, continuing from the right edge at the same height"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [170, 380, 470, 669], "desc": "the sparse approach: a few warning stakes with skulls on top"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [230, 150, 470, 420], "desc": "a lone crooked wooden post"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [300, 0, 480, 190], "desc": "open packed ground with a few rocks"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [110, 0, 400, 669], "desc": "vultures circling far away"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [450, 0, 1000, 1000], "desc": "a calm packed grey stone arena with faint painted lines, nothing busy, empty, the same stone as at the right edge, continuing at the same height"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 669, 1000, 1000], "desc": "the same scene continuing from the right edge, unchanged"}]}}
